headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Documentation audit of https://ably.com/docs covered 693 pages across 2,071 discovered URLs with 100% crawl coverage. 8 confirmed broken internal links were found, all within user-facing documentation (0 repository links). 739 links could not be verified due to authentication or rate-limiting, representing a significant blind spot. API reference coverage stands at 52.49% across 71 detected API pages, and SEO/geo issues affect 44.3% of pages. Example code reliability is estimated at 87.33%, with 83.12% of pages showing last-updated metadata.

key_findings.headline: Missing required doc layers
key_findings.business_consequence: Backfill concept/how-to/reference coverage for key capabilities.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

key_findings.headline: RAG retrieval quality risk
key_findings.business_consequence: Improve module metadata, index quality, and retrieval eval thresholds.

priority_actions.title: Fix all 8 confirmed broken internal documentation links immediately
Investigate and resolve 739 unverified links by addressing auth/rate-limit barriers or confirming validity
Increase API reference coverage from 52.49% to minimum 80% by documenting missing endpoints and improving cross-linking

strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100% of 2,071 in-scope pages)
Zero broken repository navigation links; all 8 broken links are user-facing and fixable
High example code reliability estimate at 87.33%
risks: 739 unverified links create major uncertainty; 25% link confidence indicates potential hidden broken links behind auth/rate-limits
API reference coverage at 52.49% leaves nearly half of API surface undocumented or poorly linked
SEO/geo issue rate of 44.3% significantly impacts discoverability and search ranking
Overall confidence of 63.5% suggests moderate reliability gaps across multiple dimensions
limitations: External audit cannot verify 739 links behind authentication, rate-limiting, or server blocks; actual broken link count may be higher
Crawl accessed only 693 of 2,376 requested pages; uncrawled content may contain additional issues not reflected in this analysis
API coverage detection relies on heuristics; actual documentation gaps may differ if API surface inventory is incomplete
automation_first: Scheduled docs quality checks for link health, freshness, and layer completeness.
Drift and docs-contract visibility so code changes stop outpacing reference docs.
RAG-ready normalization and retrieval quality controls for AI-facing documentation.
